boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, officially documented campus environments for individual work, collaboration, research, and media projects.

cards.title: Dallas P. Dean Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons building
cards.notes: Choose this building when you need self- or group-study options; the College says its rooms are available to students of every major.
cards.short_summary: A multi-room academic building for self-directed or collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dallas P. Dean Learning Commons has rooms for self or group study available to students of all majors.
cards.access_notes: The College describes study rooms as available to students of all majors; reserve online where required.

cards.title: 24-hour Study Commons
cards.subtitle: Dallas P. Dean Learning Commons, first floor
cards.notes: Use the first-floor Study Commons for private or collaborative work; it is designated for SMCM students and described as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor student study area with private and collaborative spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning Commons houses a 24-hour Study Commons area for all SMCM students with private and collaborative study spaces.
cards.source_title: Learning Commons Named for Dallas P. Dean '60 | St. Mary's College of Maryland
cards.access_notes: Officially described as a 24-hour area for SMCM students; check posted building notices for temporary changes.

cards.title: Brew'd Awakening
cards.subtitle: Dallas P. Dean Learning Commons café
cards.notes: Set up at the café seating when a coffee, beverage, or light snack fits your work session; it shares the Learning Commons study setting.
cards.short_summary: A café within the Learning Commons, with documented student work tables.
cards.evidence_claim: Brew'd Awakening is the Learning Commons café and serves coffee, beverages, and light snacks.
cards.access_notes: The College says it is open to students, faculty, and staff; food and drinks are sold separately.

cards.title: Hilda C. Landers Library & Archives
cards.subtitle: Building 23, across from the Campus Center
cards.notes: Start at the circulation desk for help locating a suitable area, then use the published floor plans to orient yourself inside the library.
cards.short_summary: The campus library and archives, with learning resources and published floor plans.
cards.evidence_claim: Landers Library is a campus hub for learning and research, with first-, second-, and third-floor plans published by the library.
cards.source_title: Directions and Maps | Hilda C. Landers Library & Archives
cards.access_notes: Open seven days during fall and spring; posted hours vary by day and can change for holidays and exams.

cards.title: Digital Media Lab, Room 312
cards.subtitle: Media Center, third floor of Landers Library
cards.notes: Use this lab for a focused digital-media work block; the College lists it as open to students on weekdays during stated daytime hours.
cards.short_summary: A student-accessible digital-media lab in the Library's Media Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Digital Media Lab in Room 312 is open to students Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Media Center Facilities – The Office of Information Technology | SMCM
cards.access_notes: Open to students Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.

cards.title: Presentation Classroom, Room 321
cards.subtitle: Media Center, third floor of Landers Library
cards.notes: Reserve this room when your project needs a large display, sound system, laptop connection, or whiteboard wall for shared review.
cards.short_summary: A reservable, presentation-equipped Media Center classroom.
cards.evidence_claim: Room 321 seats 75 and includes projection, sound, laptop connections, playback formats, and a whiteboard wall.
cards.source_title: Media Center Facilities – The Office of Information Technology | SMCM
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required through EMS, according to the College's Media Center facilities page.

cards.title: Skype & Zoom Room, Room 307
cards.subtitle: Media Center, third floor of Landers Library
cards.notes: Reserve this room for a meeting or remote collaboration that benefits from a smartboard and dedicated audio-video setup.
cards.short_summary: A reservable 15-seat room for video-enabled collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Room 307 seats 15 and includes HD projection, sound, DVD/VHS capability, and a smartboard.
cards.source_title: Media Center Facilities – The Office of Information Technology | SMCM
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required through EMS, according to the College's Media Center facilities page.

cards.title: Recording Studio, Room 313
cards.subtitle: Media Center, third floor of Landers Library
cards.notes: Book this studio when coursework calls for recorded audio or media production; follow the College's reservation link before planning your session.
cards.short_summary: A reservable recording space in the Library's Media Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Media Center's Recording Studio is located in Room 313 and is available to reserve.
cards.source_title: Media Center Facilities – The Office of Information Technology | SMCM
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required; use the College's linked Recording Studio reservation page.

cards.title: Campus Center Lounges
cards.subtitle: Campus Center
cards.notes: Use the lounges between classes when you want a shared campus setting for reading or laptop work, with nearby lockers for book storage.
cards.short_summary: Campus Center lounges specifically identified by the College as places to study.
cards.evidence_claim: The College identifies the Campus Center lounges as places to study, relax, and socialize between classes.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Campus Center; consult campus access information for current building availability.

cards.title: Rainbow Room
cards.subtitle: Campus Center 148
cards.notes: Visit this staffed resource room for a study session with free Wi-Fi, chairs and couches, plus LGBTQ-focused books and magazines to browse.
cards.short_summary: A staffed Campus Center resource room with Wi-Fi and study-friendly seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rainbow Room provides comfortable chairs and couches for study sessions, free Wi-Fi, and LGBTQ library materials.
cards.access_notes: Located in Campus Center 148; the College states it is open daily from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
